### Added
- **Model and runtime image signatures are verified at admission: `modelServing.imageVerification` renders a Kyverno `verifyImages` ClusterPolicy over every model pod of the serving namespace** (giantswarm/agent-platform#552). A model pod ran whatever the registry served under its references — the modelcar sidecar that carries the weights, the pre-fetch init container KServe runs from the same image and the runtime container were admitted unverified — and an installation that curates its models as signed OCI images had no way to have the platform refuse an unsigned or tampered one. Off by default; on, the connectivity chart renders `<release>-model-serving-image-verification` where the cache policies render (Kyverno served) and nowhere else: one rule per pod shape — the classic `InferenceService` predictor and the `LLMInferenceService` workload pod, Pods at CREATE and UPDATE, since a pod's container images are mutable and a CREATE-only rule would admit an image swapped into a running pod — verifying every container image that matches `images` (Kyverno's `imageReferences`, wildcards as Kyverno reads them: `gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/models/*` covers every curated model image) against `attestors`, one entry per trusted signer passed through as written into one attestor set with `count: 1` (keyless — issuer and subject or `subjectRegExp`, Rekor — a public key or certificates), `mutateDigest: true` pinning the verified tag to its digest, `required: true`, `failureAction: Enforce` (or `Audit`). Enabled with an empty `images` list, no attestor, an entry that is no Kyverno attestor entry, a `failureAction` outside the two or an unknown key fails the render naming the key. The meta chart mirrors the block (`make verify-meta` holds every leaf equal); `make verify-model-serving-policies` asserts the rendered rule of both shapes, runs the policy through `kyverno apply` over both fixture pods (every rule skipped, the policy accepted by Kyverno's schema, a misspelt field refused), nothing while disabled or without Kyverno, the guards, and the meta chart's forwarded render equal. README "Verifying model images".
